summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine private power generator, filed a Form 6-K announcing the release date for its first quarter 2026 financial results (May 12, 2026) and a corresponding earnings conference call (May 13, 2026). The filing is a routine earnings notification with no mention of any transaction, strategic alternative, corporate action, or special situation event. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are provided. This is a standard periodic report with no shareholder vote, tender offer, or restructuring element. As a non-US foreign private issuer, this Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a domestic earnings press release. No risk-arb or special-situation angle exists.
